info.name: RBPO Lab 4 — Personal Budget — Variant 28
info.description: Run folders in order. Local test user and admin must exist. Fill userPassword and adminPassword locally. Keep cookies enabled; GET CSRF first. Foreign fixture owner 3 must exist. Requests create test records. Do not export real passwords.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { pm.test("USER, password hidden", function () { const r = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(r.role).to.eql("USER"); pm.expect(r).not.to.have.property("passwordHash"); }); }

if (pm.response.code === 200) { const r = pm.response.json().find(u => u.email === pm.collectionVariables.get("userEmail")); pm.test("Test user exists", () => pm.expect(r).to.exist); if (r) pm.collectionVariables.set("ownerId", r.id); }
